meta.evidence_status: simulation (pencil model P1, synthetic handwriting and tremor)

definitions.housing: housing reference point at the nominal nib position: nominal ball-contact point fixed to the barrel (ball centre at zero stage deflection and nominal protrusion, minus r_b in z); nib minus housing = stage and axial displacement
definitions.nib: ball contact point (ball centre minus r_b in z; z < 0 is paper indentation, z > 0 lifted)
definitions.intended: reference ink: the same pencil in NEUTRAL mode on the same handwriting without tremor (harness convention; not scenario.intended)
definitions.q: stage deflection at the nib in housing axes x_H (tilt plane), y_H (sideways), mm
definitions.F_nib: paper on nib, page frame (fx, fy friction; fz normal), N
definitions.F_skid: paper on skid ring, page frame, N
definitions.F_act: net bender force referred to the nib, k_b (delta_free(V) - q), housing axes x_H, y_H, N
definitions.V: centre-electrode drive voltage of each axis (0-60 V; 30 V = neutral)
definitions.P_drive_mW: mean power drawn from the piezo drive rail, both axes, class-B / switch-to-rail stage (DRV2700 class; add its 72 mW quiescent and divide by the 0.75 boost efficiency for battery power); the charge-recovery value is P_drive_rail_recovery_mW; includes the drive activity caused by 1 um Hall noise

frame: paper: x,y on the page, z up; pen tilt theta_deg about the pen's azimuth phi_deg

cases.label: No correction (stage held at centre)
cases.note: Stage held at centre. The ink carries the hand's tremor; this is the pencil with its correction switched off.

cases.label: Physical limit (perfect disturbance knowledge)
cases.note: The stage is told the true tremor. This is what the mechanism can physically do with perfect knowledge of intent; at 0.3 mm tremor it spends about a third of the time at its travel limit.

cases.label: Tremor estimator (Kalman, frozen M1 set)
cases.note: The pen estimates the tremor from its own sensors. At 6 Hz it cannot separate tremor from writing, so it corrects almost nothing (it helps from about 8 Hz). Separating intent is the open problem.

cases.label: Guided by template
cases.note: The nib is pulled toward a template of the stroke. Judged by distance to the path: the error chart shows the nearest-point distance.
